seo_title.description: Optional search title for <title> and og:title. Defaults to "<title> · Agentware course".

description.description: Optional meta description. Defaults to the lede as plain text, cut to 160 characters.

updated.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the lesson's content, quiz or the data it shows last changed in a way a reader would notice. Set by hand. Shown under the lesson line, and used for JSON-LD dateModified and the sitemap lastmod.

agentware.description: The Agentware SDK version (X.Y.Z) the lesson describes. Required when the lesson shows SDK-derived data and data/manifest.json exists; must equal generated_with.agentware for those files. Rendered from here, so lesson prose does not state the version.

change_note.description: Optional one-sentence note for readers about the latest change, in inline Markdown (bold, italic, code).
